evcs_bus.description: Charging-station bus and phase IDs, such as 48.1, in the same order as num_evs_per_station.
evcs_bus.title: EVCS Bus

evcs_bus_assignment.description: Maps charging buses to zero-based EV indices. Leave empty to assign indices automatically from station counts.
evcs_bus_assignment.title: EVCS Bus Assignment

num_evs_per_station.description: EV count at each station, in the same order as evcs_bus.
num_evs_per_station.title: Num EVs per Station

max_charging_rate.description: Maximum charging power per EV, in kW.
max_charging_rate.title: Max Charging Rate

battery_capacity.description: Battery energy capacity per EV, in kWh.
battery_capacity.title: Battery Capacity

charging_efficiency.description: Fraction of charging energy stored in the battery; 0.95 means 95%.
charging_efficiency.title: Charging Efficiency

desired_soc.description: Target state of charge at departure; 0.9 means 90%.
desired_soc.title: Desired SOC

soc_std.description: Initial SOC normal-distribution standard deviation; 0.1 means 10 percentage points.
soc_std.title: SOC Std

soc_lower.description: Minimum sampled initial state of charge; 0.1 means 10%.
soc_lower.title: SOC Lower

soc_upper.description: Maximum sampled initial state of charge; 0.5 means 50%.
soc_upper.title: SOC Upper

arrival_mean.description: Arrival-time normal-distribution mean, in hours from simulation start.
arrival_mean.title: Arrival Mean

arrival_std.description: Arrival-time normal-distribution standard deviation, in hours.
arrival_std.title: Arrival Std

arrival_lower.description: Earliest sampled arrival, in hours from simulation start.
arrival_lower.title: Arrival Lower

arrival_upper.description: Latest sampled arrival, in hours from simulation start.
arrival_upper.title: Arrival Upper

departure_shift.description: Time offset added to the lognormal departure sample, in hours from simulation start.
departure_shift.title: Departure Shift

departure_mu.description: Mean of the departure time. Higher values generally mean later departures.
departure_mu.title: Departure Mu

departure_sigma.description: Standard deviation of the departure time. Higher values increase the spread before filtering.
departure_sigma.title: Departure Sigma

total_hours.description: EV scheduling duration in hours. Match the feeder simulation duration.
total_hours.title: Total Hours

control_interval.description: EV scheduling step in hours; 0.25 means 15 minutes. Match the feeder timestep.
control_interval.title: Control Interval

random_seed.description: Seed for repeatable arrival, departure, and initial SOC samples. Keep it fixed when comparing charging strategies.
random_seed.title: Random Seed
